name: mirage
text:
v1.0.53 is out: with GitHub driving, the phone takes no Novig or order sockets, runs no live-lane sockets for the Feed, and posts no Vigilant bets or bids of its own (they're the engine's: Settings > Cloud scan > Engine trading). One thing you may notice: the Feed's live rows come from the phone's live lane today, so they stay empty until the engine publishes them (I've queued that), and CrazyNinjaOdds auto-bets still place from the phone (also queued).
https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.53
